purpose: Fresh Gate 3 blind benchmark tranche B for the merged r10 candidate. Questions are frozen before the first live run and must not be used to tune candidate behavior before that run.
blindnessPolicy: Do not edit this tranche after its first paid live run except to preserve an immutable record of what was run.
Any failed tranche-B case may become a regression after diagnosis, but it may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche B, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
Tranche B must not exactly reuse questions from Gate 2 or Gate 3 tranche A.

cases.question: A battle is still tied after applying battle totals, and we have to make a Tiebreak Roll. Do Advantage, card bonuses, or the old battle totals affect that roll?
I withdraw during Onset before Gambits are set. Is there an Aftermath or a winner for that battle?
The battle already passed Onset and reached Gambits, then an effect makes me withdraw. Do the committed battle cards still get cleared?
At Onset, may the defender offer Terms before the attacker has had a chance to offer or pass?
My token is far beyond my Front Line and is already on the second opposing Territory beyond it. Can one normal Capture step add both opposing Territories to my Front Line?
Can my Front Line skip an opposing Territory I do not control if my token has already moved past it?
In a Last Stand, does the defender get only the +1 battle-total bonus, or do they also have Defensive Edge?
When battle cards clear normally, are Gambits and Tactics sent to the same zone?
I win two battles in the same turn as Military. Assuming I started at 0 Command, how much Command do those two wins generate from the normal faction resource rule?
I ratified my sixth different Proposal during my turn. When exactly does Peace Treaty check for the win on my next turn?
For the Financiers' Capital Limit, what contributes to the limit: controlled Territories, cards in Treasury, or both?
What exactly increases Operation Progress in v0.7.1: completing a normal Mission, merely starting one, or completing a Special Operation?
After I have completed two Rites, what does Transmutation let me do before dice are rolled?
Purification checks an empty Draw Pile and Discard Pile. Does it trigger from any failed draw, or specifically from the opponent's normal start-of-turn draw?
The General wins as attacker and uses Rout at the end of Aftermath. If the one-Position advance reaches the opponent, may that Rout movement initiate another battle?
The Commandant wins while occupying an enemy Territory. What does Fortify do to the Front Line?
I already drew from Cordiality once this turn. Later, my opponent accepts another set of my Terms in a separate battle. Can I draw again?
The Senator loses an ordinary battle in which no Terms were refused. Can Political Capital be used to recover anything from that loss?
The Banker already used Line of Credit on a Deed purchase this turn. Can the Banker use new collateral on a second Deed purchase in the same turn?
The Executive just won as attacker and is occupying that enemy Territory. Is Hostile Takeover a free immediate effect, or does it require an Action during Denouement?
A card effect, not a printed Territory effect, would penalize the Ranger. Can Fieldcraft spend 1 Intel to ignore that card effect?
Mission Control starts another eligible normal Mission after the Spymaster completes one. May that replacement Mission also complete during the same turn?
The Alchemist puts two qualifying cards from Hand into the Graveyard on the same turn for Arcane effects. How many times can Materia Prima draw from those sacrifices?
The Spirit Walker has completed all three Rites when a battle loss would interrupt the Ritual. What minimum card value can Guardians of the Circle use to prevent that interruption?
When the Grand Inquisitor uses Final Judgment after a battle win, how much does it reduce that Purge's Conviction cost, and how low can the cost go?
Relentless Pursuit ends the attacking opponent's turn and then moves the Witch Hunter forward. If that movement starts a battle, who is the attacker?
I use Sedition as a Gambit or Tactic while my opponent has face-up Assets. Who chooses the Asset that becomes inactive during the battle?
I play Sequestration for its Action while both players have several Assets. How many Assets does each player keep, if able?
Sleeper Network is Removed while it has several cards bound beneath it. How many of those bound cards may be played immediately for their Action effects?
For Soul for Soul's Action, which two zones supply the cards being exchanged?
I placed Speculation beside a Territory with its Action. At the start of my next turn I neither occupy nor control that Territory. Where does Speculation go?
Spies reveals the opponent's face-down Tactic before normal Tactic reveal. After seeing it, what may I do with my own Tactics?
Spirit Hollow is on a Territory when that Territory is captured. What happens to the Spirit Hollow Overlay?
I have Stand Ground banked and lose a battle. Can I discard Stand Ground to ignore my normal required retreat?
An opposing Asset effect is about to apply while I have Subversion. What does Subversion do to that effect and to the opposing Asset if it remains in play?
My Tactical Planning Gambit gives +1 Reserve when Gambits are revealed. Does that also raise my Tactic limit?
So does that mean I get to choose one more Tactic too?

history.content: What does Tactical Planning do when I set it as a Gambit?
When Gambits are revealed, Tactical Planning gives you +1 Reserve.

cases.question: If it gets Removed instead, can I play all the cards under it?

history.content: Sleeper Network has three cards bound beneath it. What happens when I use its Action?
Its Asset text lets you put Sleeper Network in your Graveyard, reveal the bound cards, and play each bound card you can for its Action effect.

cases.question: And where does that Overlay go if the Territory gets captured later?

history.content: What does Spirit Hollow do after a battle on its Territory?
After battle cards are cleared, each player may sacrifice a card from Hand to move another card from their Graveyard to their Discard Pile.

cases.question: Different question: my Commandant just won while occupying their Territory. Can Fortify advance my Front Line?

history.content: When exactly does Peace Treaty check for six ratified Proposals?
Peace Treaty checks at the start of the Diplomat player's turn.

cases.question: Counterworks says the prevented card is discarded but does not name a destination. Does the written v0.7.1 authority tell us whether that means its owner's Discard Pile or Graveyard?
Which Gauntlet faction do you personally think is the most fun to play?
I am the Witch Hunter defending when the attacker withdraws during Onset. Does Relentless Pursuit trigger from that encounter?
